title: Evaluating Memanto on DolphinBench for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.28231v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory benchmarks built on question answering tell an agent which fact to recall. Workplace requests often leave that need implicit: to post an update in the team's channel, an agent must work out which channel from earlier interactions and use it in a tool call. We evaluate Memanto, a memory agent that ranks memories with an information-theoretic relevance score, on DolphinBench, which tests memory through 600 simulated workplace tasks, each validated as requiring memory. Running in the Hermes agent harness with GPT-6-Luna and at most 6 iterations per conversation, Memanto completes 503 tasks (83.83%). The strongest configuration reported by the benchmark's authors, Mem0 with GPT-5.6-Luna and up to 60 iterations, completes 424 (70.67%). Memanto's run also has the lowest total cost ($10.86, against $61.48 for the cheapest reported run) and the shortest median task latency (15.32s). translated_title: 在面向AI智能体的DolphinBench上评估Memanto
translated_abstract: 基于问答的记忆基准测试会明确告诉智能体需要回忆哪个事实。而职场请求往往让这种需求保持隐含：例如要在团队频道发布更新，智能体必须从早先的交互中推断出应使用哪个频道，并将其用于工具调用中。我们在DolphinBench上评估了Memanto——一种使用信息论相关性分数对记忆进行排序的记忆智能体。DolphinBench通过600个模拟职场任务来测试记忆能力，每个任务都经过验证确实需要记忆。Memanto在Hermes智能体框架中运行，使用GPT-6-Luna模型，每次对话最多6次迭代，完成了503个任务（83.83%）。该基准测试作者报告的最强配置——使用GPT-5.6-Luna且最多60次迭代的Mem0——完成了424个任务（70.67%）。Memanto的运行还具有最低的总成本（10.86美元，而已报告的最便宜运行为61.48美元）和最短的中位任务延迟（15.32秒）。评分使用该基准测试自带的评判器，但该智能体（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Memanto记忆智能体凭借信息论相关性分数对记忆排序，在DolphinBench职场记忆基准上以更少的迭代次数（最多6次）、更低的成本（10.86美元）和更短的延迟（15.32秒中位数）取得83.83%的任务完成率，显著超越此前最强的Mem0配置（70.67%）。
en_tdlr: Memanto, a memory agent that ranks memories with an information-theoretic relevance score, achieves 83.83% task completion on DolphinBench with fewer iterations (max 6), lower cost ($10.86), and shorter latency (15.32s median), significantly outperforming the previously strongest Mem0 configuration (70.67%).
